title: B4 wide-street 100-ft buffer/intersection engine (EPSG:2263): planar buffer over wide-disposed DCM segments intersected with the MapPLUTO lot polygon, portions-aware, fail-closed
objective: Implement B4 per the accepted M4-T016 A2 research (Part 4.3 item 2; design Part 2.2 steps A-D; edge cases Part 2.4): a NEW deterministic geometry-engine module services/api/app/connectors/wide_street_buffer_engine.py (the dcm_street_width_policy.py sibling precedent) plus its test file. Contract: (1) TYPED INPUTS - wide-disposed DCM segment polylines (the accepted M4-T020 dcm_street_centerline_geometry results, filtered by the caller to effective_disposition == wide via the accepted M4-T015 classifier / M4-T019 policy - NEVER re-implemented or re-decided here) and the MapPLUTO zoning-lot polygon (the accepted mappluto_geometry_arcgis measurement surface); BOTH inputs must carry their validated EPSG:2263 identity (wkid 102718 / latestWkid 2263) - absence or mismatch on either side is a TYPED error; NO reprojection path may exist (the same-CRS simplification is evidenced in Part 2.3, not assumed). (2) BUFFER - a planar buffer of exactly 100.0 US survey feet per wide segment polyline (shapely 2.0.7, ALREADY ADMITTED with GEOS-determinism assertions - zero new dependencies), valid only in the projected foot-unit CRS, never degrees. (3) INTERSECTION - the boolean any-portion intersects test (ZR 23-22 footnote 1 'or portions thereof', quoted verbatim in r6_r7_r8_wide_street_conditional_far.rule.json) AND the intersection sub-geometry/area exposed for the rule layer's future apportionment; per-segment contributions AND the union-before-intersect aggregate both visible. (4) EDGE CASES TYPED per Part 2.4: EC-1 corner/multi-frontage handled by union-by-construction; EC-2 ambiguous/narrow segments are EXCLUDED by the caller's wide-only input contract and the module must document the resulting honest under-claim (M4-T013-style tradeoff section in the producer report); EC-3 always per-segment - never one-width-per-named-street; EC-4 exact-100-ft tangency: NO silent tolerance - BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE_FT (a positional-accuracy constant) must NOT be reused as a legal buffer allowance; the exact floating-point predicate result stands and the open tolerance question is DOCUMENTED, not resolved; EC-5 the named-street override (Broadway W94-97 CD7; Allen St Rivington-Delancey CD3) and the C5-3/C6-4/C6-6 alternate-width clause are OUT of this module's scope - the API must carry a typed no-default attested-preconditions input (the D-052/M4-T019 AttestedPreconditions precedent) so a caller cannot silently skip them (B7 wires them LAST); EC-6 an empty wide-segment input set produces a typed honest 'no wide segment provided' result, never a default in either direction. (5) DETERMINISM + PROVENANCE - shapely.__version__ and geos_version_string asserted (pyproject discipline); every result carries the inputs' provenance (retrieval identities, raw digests, CRS stamps, classifier basis passthrough) and the 100.0-ft constant's citation. (6) Zero new dependencies; accepted modules READ-ONLY; NO rule-file or ruleset edits (B7 is a later packet). Producer report to project-control/reports/M4-T021-producer-report.md.
